declaration.preface: Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is dedicated to conducting its business with integrity, transparency, and accountability. The company acknowledges its duty to maintain the highest ethical standards across all operations. Ethical behaviour is essential for fostering trust among customers, employees, suppliers, and stakeholders. The Ethics Policy acts as a guiding framework for ethical decision-making within the organization, outlining commitments to compliance, fair business practices, human rights, environmental responsibility, data privacy, and whistleblower protection.
declaration.declaration:
At Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd., we integrate ethical considerations into our daily operations and decision-making processes. Our approach is rooted in embedding ethical values into corporate culture, which is essential and can be achieved through effective leadership and employee engagement. Regular risk assessments should be conducted to identify and mitigate potential ethical issues. Additionally, providing training programs enhances awareness and understanding of ethical standards. It is crucial to establish clear policies and procedures that guide ethical behaviour across all business functions. Collaborating with industry partners, NGOs, and regulatory bodies helps organizations stay aligned with global ethical standards.

We set annual goals, develop necessary capabilities, and commit appropriate resources to achieve this policy through innovation, operational efficiency, and aligning Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. supply chain with this policy.

Considering calendar year 2022 as the Baseline year for measuring progress and achievements in our sustainability initiatives.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, stakeholders, contractors, partners, customers, contractual workers, and anyone acting on behalf of following sites:

Compliance with Laws and Regulations: All relevant National and International laws and regulations are closely adhered to by Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. We guarantee compliance with labor laws, environmental rules, anti-corruption laws, and ethical business practices. Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. has established a key commitment to ethical business practices.
Bribery: We uphold strict anti-corruption policies and ensure that all business dealings are conducted with honesty and transparency.
Conduct regular internal audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate corruption risks.
We are committed to maintain a strict policy of zero tolerance towards any form of corruption. This unwavering stance reflects our dedication to integrity and ethical conduct in all our operations.
Employees must not offer, accept, or solicit bribes, kickbacks, or any improper payments.
Strengthening Data Protection: We uphold the highest standards of data privacy and security to protect the personal and business information of our employees, customers, and partners.
Implement encryption and access control to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.
Conflict of Interest: Employees need to be aware of the potential for the conflict of interest to arise and should always act in the best interest of Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.
Require employees to submit an annual Conflict of Interest Disclosure Statement, identifying any personal or financial relationships that may pose a conflict.
Employees must disclose any personal or financial interest that could influence their business decisions.
Fraud: Develop clear guidelines on ethical behaviour, fraud risks, and reporting procedures to empower employees to act with integrity.
Establish a confidential whistleblower program to enable employees and stakeholders to report suspected fraud anonymously and without retaliation.
Financial Crime: Conduct mandatory Anti- Money Laundering (AML) training programs for employees.
Establish a risk assessment framework to continuously evaluate and manage AML-related risks within business operations.
Unfair Trade Practices: Promote a culture of integrity and ethical business conduct, ensuring that employees understand the importance of free and fair competition.
Require all suppliers, distributors, and business partners to comply with Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.  Anti-Competitive Practices.
Employees must compete fairly and not engage in anti-competitive practices such as price-fixing or market manipulation.
Ensuring Ethical Supply Chains: We continuously engage with our suppliers to ensure fair labor practices, responsible sourcing, and ethical procurement.
Promoting Diversity and Inclusion: We foster a workplace that values diversity, promotes equal opportunities, and supports a culture of inclusivity.
Discrimination, harassment, and workplace bullying are strictly prohibited.
Information Security: We prioritize cybersecurity awareness and data security.
Employees must safeguard customer, employee, and company data from unauthorized access or disclosure.
Ethical Supplier Certification: We seek to achieve maximum of our suppliers are certified under recognized ethical standards, such as Fair Trade or equivalent, by 2026.
We plan to collaborate with ethically certified suppliers which strengthens the integrity of the supply chain by 2026.
Integrity and Honesty: Employees must be honest in all business dealings and avoid deceptive practices.
Fair Competition: Employees must compete fairly and not engage in anti-competitive practices such as price-fixing or market manipulation.
Workplace Respect and Inclusion: Discrimination, harassment, and workplace bullying are strictly prohibited.
Anti-Bribery and Corruption: Employees must not offer, accept, or solicit bribes, kickbacks, or any improper payments.
Confidentiality and Data Protection: Employees must safeguard customer, employee, and company data from unauthorized access or disclosure.
Whistleblower Protection: Employees who report ethical violations in good faith will be protected from retaliation.

responsibilities.duty: Oversee the implementation and effectiveness of the Ethics Policy.
Ensure that ethical risks are identified and mitigated at the highest level.
Developing and executing ethical policies in alignment with corporate goals.
Monitoring compliance with ethical commitments across the organization and reporting on ethics progress to the Board and stakeholders.
Communicate the importance of ethical behaviour to employees and monitor compliance with the Ethics Policy in daily operations.
Identify potential ethical risks and address them proactively and encourage employees to participate in ethics training and awareness programs.
Familiarize themselves with and adhere to the Ethics Policy and contribute to an ethical workplace culture by treating colleagues, customers, and stakeholders with respect.
Report any suspected ethical violations through proper channels and act with integrity in all professional dealings.

policy.monitoring:
All reported violations will be thoroughly investigated by the Compliance Manager and relevant authorities within the company.

Depending on the severity of the violation, corrective actions will be implemented, including policy reinforcement, additional training, or procedural adjustments.

Employees or stakeholders found guilty of ethical misconduct may face disciplinary actions such as warnings, suspension, or termination of employment or business relationships.

In cases involving fraud, corruption, or serious ethical breaches, legal action may be taken in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Any employee or stakeholder reporting violations in good faith will be protected from retaliation.

Ethical compliance audits will be conducted periodically to ensure adherence to company policies and standards.

Praveen Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. upholds robust governance by integrating ethical and environmental responsibility into its corporate framework. Leadership plays a pivotal role in ensuring compliance, fostering transparency, and maintaining the highest standards of accountability. A dedicated compliance team actively oversees adherence to ethical guidelines, proactively identifying and mitigating potential risks. Regular audits and evaluations are conducted to assess policy effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

The organization cultivates a culture of ethical business practices at all levels, prioritizing integrity, fair competition, and responsible decision-making. Employees are empowered to voice concerns through a well-structured grievance mechanism, ensuring that ethical violations are addressed promptly and without fear of retaliation. Collaboration with industry partners, regulatory bodies, and stakeholders further reinforces the company’s unwavering commitment to sustainability, corporate responsibility, and long-term ethical excellence.

External reporting is conducted annually to communicate our ethical performance to stakeholders, including employees, customers, investors, and regulatory bodies.

Reports are prepared in accordance with internationally recognized standards such as the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) guidelines.

We require suppliers to submit annual reports on their ethical compliance, including any corrective actions taken.

Audits and third-party assessments are conducted to verify compliance with our Supplier Code of Conduct.

We actively engage with employees, suppliers, and other stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and foster transparency in our ethical practices.

Regular stakeholder meetings and surveys help assess the effectiveness of our ethics initiatives and inform continuous improvement efforts.

A formal grievance mechanism is in place to ensure employees and external stakeholders can report violations confidentially and without fear of retaliation.

Grievance reports are reviewed by the Compliance Manager and addressed according to established procedures.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Compliance Officer reviews this policy annually to ensure alignment with changing regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and stakeholder expectations.

Company can also change or review policy if any necessary changes is required.

Updates to the policy are communicated internally, and relevant training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance with ethical standards.
